publication issues.summary: Early unsealed partial candidate: 255 unresolved render differences including 5 wire glyph differences; the classified report list is truncated. One unresolved output identifier conflict, printed AT4 versus routed source AM4, requires native and source review. Full native wiring, junctions, crossings, omission, registration and schema status remain unestablished. Team2 finite review partitions the 255 unresolved cells into five wiring-glyph differences and 250 footer listing cells; footer cells were not individually reconciled. A crop near [92,12] shows a diamond at D09, while mapping other nearby crossings and diamonds is ambiguous without independent registration. The [242,59] crop contains adjacent labels, one resembling AM4; the printed AT4 versus routed AM4 identity remains unresolved. Ten of 296 route panels were viewed; panels 10–295, 24 junctions, 102 crossings, omissions and full per-record review remain open. Block fit 64/72 median 1.60 pixels is model-dependent; independent edge and scan-warp controls remain open. External schema was not run.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
